Title: Creates a temporary commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of Legionnaires' Disease caused by cooling towers in New York city; repealer
Summary: Creates a temporary commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of Legionnaires' Disease caused by cooling towers in New York city; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.
ActClause: AN ACT to create a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of Legionnaires' Disease caused by cooling towers in New York city; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof
